OSPS-AC-01.01.justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication of every member and accepts only secure methods, not SMS. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/1362#issuecomment-5903994882

OSPS-AC-02.01.justification: A new member gets read access, the organization's base permission (gh api orgs/btclib-org --jq .default_repository_permission). This repository has no direct collaborator. A higher grant is an issue in btclib-org/.github that an owner other than the one asking approves. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#how-a-decision-is-made

OSPS-AC-03.01.justification: The main-self-merge ruleset requires a pull request for every change to main. Its one bypass actor holds it in pull_request mode, which excuses a merge and never a direct push. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets

OSPS-AC-03.02.justification: The main-integrity ruleset forbids deleting main and has no bypass actor. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#rulesets

OSPS-AC-04.01.justification: The default GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only and cannot approve pull requests (gh api repos/btclib-org/portanode/actions/permissions/workflow). Every workflow also sets permissions: contents: read at the top. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#token-permissions

OSPS-AC-04.02.justification: Every workflow sets permissions: contents: read at the top. Four jobs add scopes: claude-review (pull-requests: write and id-token: write), codeql and scorecard (security-events: write, scorecard also id-token: write, both actions: read), and the test aggregate (actions: read, to read its own run's jobs). zizmor's excessive-permissions audit runs in the required Lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/claude-review.yml

OSPS-BR-01.01.justification: No workflow uses pull_request_target or workflow_run. No run: step expands an event field; verified-signatures.yml's inputs reach a script only through env:. zizmor's template-injection audit runs in the required Lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

OSPS-BR-01.03.justification: Pull-request runs use the pull_request and pull_request_review_comment triggers, which give a fork no secrets and a read-only token. The review job, which holds a secret, runs only when the head repository is this one. On issue_comment, the mention job checks out the default branch. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-claude-review.yml

OSPS-BR-01.04.justification: Only verified-signatures.yml takes workflow_dispatch inputs, before and after. They reach the script through env:, and the script refuses any value that is not a hex commit sha. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-verified-signatures.yml

OSPS-BR-02.01.justification: Each release has a unique calendar version, YYYY.M.D, set by a signed v* tag. A fix to a shipped release is another day's release. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md#the-version-string

OSPS-BR-02.02.justification: The only asset of a release is GitHub's source archive, named after the tag: portanode-2026.10.26.zip for v2026.10.26. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/releases/latest

OSPS-BR-03.01.justification: Every official channel is served over HTTPS only: the GitHub repository, its issue tracker, its Security tab and its releases. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

OSPS-BR-03.02.justification: The project is distributed only from GitHub, over HTTPS: git clone, the ZIP of main and the release's source archive. Each release is a signed tag. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/releases

OSPS-BR-04.01.justification: The GitHub release body is RELEASE_NOTES.md's section for that release: what a user must act on. CHANGELOG.md lists what changed. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

OSPS-BR-05.01.justification: No build ingests a dependency, and a release is a tag. CI installs its tools with pre-commit at the revisions .pre-commit-config.yaml pins, and every third-party action is pinned by commit SHA. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

OSPS-BR-06.01.justification: Each release is a signed annotated tag, and GitHub verifies its signature. The tag covers the commit and every file in it. The source archive GitHub generates carries no signature of its own. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/tags

OSPS-BR-07.01.justification: Secret scanning and its push protection are on. The detect-private-key and detect-secrets hooks run in the required Lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#security-settings

OSPS-BR-07.02.justification: A secret is an environment secret that only the owners reach. A secret kept in any other store is recorded in the REPOSITORY.md of the repository that uses it, and btclib-org/.github's tests/secrets_test.py refuses an unrecorded one. A secret is rotated when an owner changes or an exposure is suspected. The secrets kept outside an environment are rotated before they are a year old, and the list is reviewed yearly. This repository holds no secret of its own. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#tokens-publishing-scanning https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#secrets

OSPS-DO-01.01.justification: README.md is the user guide: getting the folder, the quick start, each launcher, updating and rolling back the binaries, and troubleshooting. Each scripts directory has its own README.md. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md

OSPS-DO-02.01.justification: README.md's Getting Help says to search the open issues and file through the bug form. CONTRIBUTING.md's The issue tracker says where an issue goes, and the security policy sends a vulnerability to a private channel. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml

OSPS-DO-03.01.justification: VERIFYING.md tells a user how to check a release: import the maintainer's key from GitHub, compare its fingerprint, then run git verify-tag on a clone. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/VERIFYING.md

OSPS-DO-03.02.justification: VERIFYING.md names the key a release tag is signed by, by fingerprint, and the earlier, revoked key apart. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/VERIFYING.md

OSPS-DO-04.01.justification: The security policy's Supported versions says that only the latest release is supported, nothing is backported, and a fix is a new release. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions

OSPS-DO-05.01.justification: The security policy: only the latest release is supported, so a release stops receiving security updates when the next one is published. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions

OSPS-DO-06.01.justification: README.md's Updating Binaries says how Bitcoin Core and Electrum are obtained and verified: from their publishers, with PGP signatures from pinned keys. .github/dependabot.yml says how the actions are tracked, and .pre-commit-config.yaml's ci: block how the hook revisions are. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries

OSPS-DO-07.01.justification: Nothing is built: README.md's Getting the folder and Updating Binaries say how to assemble a working folder, and Prerequisites names gpg. CONTRIBUTING.md gives the development environment: uv, then uvx pre-commit. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#getting-the-folder

OSPS-GV-01.01.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's Roles names who holds access to sensitive resources: fametrano is the maintainer, and the three owners, named by login, administer every repository. This repository has no direct collaborator. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

OSPS-GV-01.02.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's Roles describes the maintainer, owners, repository collaborators, contributors, reviewers, the review bot, Dependabot and pre-commit.ci, and what each owes. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

OSPS-GV-02.01.justification: Proposed changes and usage obstacles are discussed publicly in the repository's GitHub issues and pull requests; cross-repository questions go to btclib-org/.github's tracker. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues

OSPS-GV-03.01.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process: one subject per pull request, the local gates, the review and the landing. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-03.02.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states what a contribution must meet: one subject, a Signed-off-by trailer on every commit, the gates CI runs, and a review against REVIEWING.md. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-04.01.justification: A grant of write or admin, to any repository of the organization, is an issue in btclib-org/.github that states the reason, and an owner other than the one asking approves it there. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#how-a-decision-is-made

OSPS-LE-01.01.justification: main requires the Sign-off check, which refuses a commit that lacks its author's Signed-off-by: trailer, Dependabot's and pre-commit.ci's aside. Web commits are signed off automatically. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/scripts/check_sign_off.py

OSPS-LE-02.01.justification: The source code is under the MIT license, which the OSI approves. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-LE-02.02.justification: The only release asset is GitHub's source archive of the tag, which carries the same MIT LICENSE file. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/releases/latest

OSPS-LE-03.01.justification: The license text is the repository's root LICENSE file. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-LE-03.02.justification: The release's source archive holds the root LICENSE file; .gitattributes excludes nothing from it. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-QA-01.01.justification: The repository is public on GitHub at a static URL. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

OSPS-QA-01.02.justification: Git history on GitHub records every change with its author, committer and date; linear history and no force-push on main keep it from being rewritten. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/commits/main

OSPS-QA-02.01.justification: Bash, batch and PowerShell have no package manager here, and the tree has no manifest or lock file. The binaries the updaters install are fetched from their publishers and pinned by keys/*.fingerprints. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml

OSPS-QA-02.02.justification: A release ships no compiled asset: its only asset is GitHub's source archive of scripts and text. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md

OSPS-QA-03.01.justification: main requires the Lint, Dependency review, Sign-off, Script security and test: every job passed checks. enforce_admins is off, so an admin merge without them is a manual bypass, which the control allows. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#what-gates-a-merge

OSPS-QA-04.01.justification: The organization standard's section 2 lists every repository of btclib-org and its tier, portanode included. PortaNode is this one repository. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github#which-repositories-and-how-far

OSPS-QA-04.02.justification: Each release is built from this single repository and from no subproject. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

OSPS-QA-05.01.justification: No generated executable is committed: git ls-files names no binary file. The bin/ directories hold only a README.md and a .gitignore naming the binaries the updaters install. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/macos/bin/.gitignore

OSPS-QA-05.02.justification: The tree holds no binary file of any kind: every tracked file is text. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

OSPS-QA-06.01.justification: The tree has an automated test suite under tests/. test.yml runs tests/run.sh and the PowerShell tests that start no cmd.exe on Ubuntu, on every pull request and every push to main; its aggregate job `test: every job passed` is a required check. The macOS and Windows halves run by hand before a release. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates

OSPS-QA-06.02.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md's The environment and the gates gives the command that runs the gates and the command that runs the suite, says lint.yml and test.yml run them on every pull request, and says the macOS and Windows halves of the suite are run by hand. lint.yml also runs on every push to main. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates

OSPS-QA-06.03.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md says a major change adds or updates tests: one that gives a launcher or a helper a new behaviour, or corrects one. tests/README.md says how a test is added. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates

OSPS-QA-07.01.justification: The main-self-merge ruleset requires one approving review from somebody other than the author, but the maintainer bypasses it in pull_request mode and can merge without one. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#rulesets

OSPS-SA-01.01.justification: README.md names the actors and actions: the user and the launchers, the per-platform scripts they reach, Bitcoin Core and Electrum, the publishers' download sites, gpg and the user's keyring. Updating Binaries and Limitations, not vulnerabilities say what each update, verification and rollback does and whom it trusts. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#folder-structure https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#limitations-not-vulnerabilities

OSPS-SA-02.01.justification: README.md and each scripts directory's README.md document the interface: every launcher and its menu, the PORTANODE_ROOT and PORTANODE_NO_NOTIFY variables, the pin files and the exit statuses of set-permissions. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md

OSPS-SA-03.01.justification: README.md's Limitations, not vulnerabilities assesses the known risks of running the folder: the user's keyring as the trust root, checksums that give integrity and not authenticity, an unencrypted portable folder, Bitcoin Core's exFAT warning, and unsigned launchers; ASSURANCE_CASE.md assesses the threats and the weaknesses. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#limitations-not-vulnerabilities https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

OSPS-SA-03.02.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md's Threat model names what is defended, the adversaries and what is not defended; its Entry points and Trust boundaries map where untrusted input enters. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

OSPS-VM-01.01.justification: The security policy's Reporting a vulnerability gives the private channels and the timeframes: a report is acknowledged within 7 days, and a fix or a published advisory follows within 90 days. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/policy

OSPS-VM-02.01.justification: The security policy on the Security tab, the organization's SECURITY.md, names the contacts: a private GitHub security advisory, or email to security at btclib dot org. GOVERNANCE.md's Roles says that address reaches every owner. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/policy https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

OSPS-VM-03.01.justification: Private vulnerability reporting is enabled, and the security policy and the issue form's contact link point to it, with an email address as the alternative. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/advisories/new

OSPS-VM-04.01.justification: A vulnerability is published as a GitHub security advisory on this repository, as the security policy says. None has been published. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/advisories

OSPS-VM-04.02.justification: A release ships no third-party component: Bitcoin Core and Electrum are fetched from their publishers at update time and are not in the tree or the release. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/AUTHORS.md

OSPS-VM-05.01.justification: The standard sets the threshold: actions/dependency-review-action fails a pull request that adds or changes a dependency with an advisory of moderate severity or above, or with a licence outside the allow-list. Its settings are btclib-org/.github's .github/dependency-review.yml. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/dependency-review.yml

OSPS-VM-05.02.justification: RELEASING.md's Cutting one reads the open Dependabot and code-scanning alerts and stops while any is open, with a command that exits 0 only where there is none and both calls answered. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md#cutting-one

OSPS-VM-05.03.justification: The required Dependency review check runs on every pull request and blocks a change that adds a dependency with an advisory of moderate severity or above, or a licence outside the allow-list. The only dependencies it can see are the pinned actions. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/lint.yml

OSPS-VM-06.01.justification: The threshold is zero: a finding of any hook in .pre-commit-config.yaml fails the required Lint check, and CONTRIBUTING.md's What gates a merge says a red Lint stops the merge. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-gates-a-merge-and-what-only-reports

OSPS-VM-06.02.justification: The required Lint check runs shellcheck on the .sh and .command scripts, zizmor and actionlint on the workflows, and detect-secrets on every file; the required Script security check runs PSScriptAnalyzer's security rules on the .ps1 scripts and Blinter's Error and Security rules on the .bat scripts, and CodeQL runs over the workflow files. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/script-security.yml

access_continuity.justification: The organization has three owners, fametrano, giacomocaironi and pmazzocchi, each an administrator of this repository. If one becomes unavailable, the other two can still close issues, merge changes and cut a release. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity

accessibility_best_practices.justification: The launchers are plain-text numbered menus driven from the keyboard, with no colour, which a screen reader can read. The project site is GitHub. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#launcher-notes

assurance_case.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md gives what is claimed, the threat model, the entry points, the trust boundaries, the secure design principles and the common implementation weaknesses with what counters each. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

automated_integration_testing.justification: test.yml runs tests/run.sh and the PowerShell tests that start no cmd.exe on Ubuntu, on every pull request and every push to main; its aggregate job `test: every job passed` is a required check. The macOS and Windows halves run by hand before a release. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml

build.justification: Nothing is built: the launchers are scripts run as they are, and the binaries they start are the publishers' own. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md

build_preserve_debug.justification: There is no build or installation system: the folder is cloned or unzipped as it is. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#getting-the-folder

build_repeatable.justification: No building occurs: the scripts are used directly. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md

build_reproducible.justification: No building occurs: the scripts are used directly. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md

bus_factor.justification: fametrano made most of the commits and filed almost every issue. pmazzocchi, an organization owner, has made 16 commits and filed 11 issues since 2026-10-17. Knowledge of the code rests on fametrano alone. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/graphs/contributors

code_of_conduct.justification: btclib-org/.github's CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is this repository's code of conduct, through GitHub's organization-wide default; the community-profile API reports it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md

code_review_standards.justification: REVIEWING.md states what a review checks, how a finding is written and what clears a pull request. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REVIEWING.md

coding_standards.justification: No style guide is named for bash, batch or PowerShell. shellcheck checks correctness, not a style. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

coding_standards_enforced.justification: No coding style is selected, so none is enforced. The hooks enforce whitespace, line endings and shellcheck's correctness checks. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

contribution.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the process: issues, one pull request per subject, the review and the landing. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

contribution_requirements.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states the requirements: the Signed-off-by trailer, the gates that must pass, and REVIEWING.md, which the change is reviewed against. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

contributors_unassociated.justification: fametrano is the only significant contributor; pmazzocchi, an organization owner, has made 16 commits and filed 11 issues, and is associated with fametrano: both are CheckSig co-founders, as their GitHub profiles state. The other committers are Dependabot and pre-commit.ci. https://github.com/fametrano https://github.com/pmazzocchi

copyright_per_file.justification: No script carries a copyright statement; the tree's COPYRIGHT file holds it. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/COPYRIGHT

crypto_algorithm_agility.justification: Signatures are checked by gpg, which accepts the OpenPGP algorithms the publishers use. A publisher's new key is a one-line change to a pin file only for a v4 key: a pin line must be 40 hex characters. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/keys/electrum.fingerprints

crypto_call.justification: Nothing is reimplemented: signatures are checked by gpg, and hashes computed by sha256sum, shasum or Get-FileHash. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/shared/utilities/lib.sh

crypto_certificate_verification.justification: No script turns certificate verification off: none passes --insecure, -k or -SkipCertificateCheck. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

crypto_credential_agility.justification: PortaNode processes no credential or private key: Bitcoin Core's RPC cookie and the wallets are Bitcoin Core's and Electrum's own. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/bitcoin-datadir/bitcoin.conf

crypto_floss.justification: Signature checks use GnuPG, which is FLOSS, and hashing uses the system's SHA-256 tools.

crypto_keylength.justification: PortaNode generates and selects no key. It checks the publishers' signatures with keys the user imports and pins. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries

crypto_password_storage.justification: PortaNode stores no password for authenticating users. bitcoin.conf sets no RPC password. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/bitcoin-datadir/bitcoin.conf

crypto_pfs.justification: PortaNode implements no key agreement protocol.

crypto_published.justification: The software uses only OpenPGP signatures, checked by gpg, and SHA-256 checksums. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries

crypto_random.justification: PortaNode generates no cryptographic key or nonce.

crypto_tls12.justification: On Windows, every download raises the session to TLS 1.2 where the protocol is not the system default (#730); curl on macOS and Linux supports TLS 1.2 and is restricted to HTTPS. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/pull/730

crypto_used_network.justification: Every download URL is HTTPS, and the Electrum local-server launcher connects over TLS. On macOS and Linux curl is called through curl_https, which restricts the protocol and every redirect to HTTPS. Whether the Windows updaters' Invoke-WebRequest calls follow a redirect to plain HTTP is not known (ISS 695). https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/shared/utilities/lib.sh

crypto_verification_private.justification: Certificates are verified before any request, and no request carries a cookie or credential. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

crypto_weaknesses.justification: Key pinning depends on SHA-1: the pin files name keys by OpenPGP v4 fingerprint, which is SHA-1 over the key (RFC 4880 section 12.2), and the check compares the signing key's fingerprint with them. The downloads themselves are checked with SHA-256. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/keys/electrum.fingerprints

crypto_working.justification: No script uses MD4, MD5, DES or RC4: the checks are OpenPGP signatures and SHA-256 checksums. The pin files name keys by OpenPGP v4 fingerprint, which is SHA-1 over the key (RFC 4880 section 12.2), as the OpenPGP keys the publishers use require. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries

dco.justification: main requires the Sign-off check, which refuses a pull request with a commit that lacks its author's Signed-off-by: trailer. CONTRIBUTING.md links the DCO. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests

delivery_mitm.justification: The project is delivered from GitHub over HTTPS, and each release is a signed tag. The updaters download over HTTPS and check PGP signatures. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

delivery_unsigned.justification: No hash is fetched over HTTP: every download URL is HTTPS. Bitcoin Core's SHA256SUMS is used only after its PGP signature is checked. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries

dependency_monitoring.justification: Dependabot alerts and security updates are on, and Dependency review is a required check. Bitcoin Core and Electrum are not pinned: the updaters fetch each publisher's latest release. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml

description_good.justification: README.md says PortaNode runs Bitcoin Core and Electrum from one folder on an external disk that macOS, Windows and Linux share. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md

discussion.justification: GitHub issues and pull requests: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues

documentation_achievements.justification: README.md links the OpenSSF Scorecard, Best Practices and Baseline badges on the lines the organization standard reserves for them. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md

documentation_architecture.justification: README.md's Folder Structure and Launcher Notes describe the root launchers, the per-platform menus and scripts, the bin/ directories and the data directories, and how a launcher reaches each. ASSURANCE_CASE.md's Entry points and Secure design principles describe the shared library under shared/ and the pin files under keys/. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#folder-structure https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md#entry-points

documentation_basics.justification: README.md covers getting the folder, the quick start, each launcher, updating, troubleshooting and the security notes. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md

documentation_current.justification: REVIEWING.md blocks a pull request on a false sentence in the tree's documentation, and links.yml checks every link weekly. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REVIEWING.md

documentation_interface.justification: README.md and each scripts directory's README.md describe every launcher, its menu, the environment variables and the pin files. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md

documentation_roadmap.justification: ROADMAP.md, organization-wide, says portanode is maintained as it is, with no new features planned; it is reviewed every September. README.md links it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/ROADMAP.md

documentation_security.justification: README.md says what a user can and cannot expect: Updating Binaries says the PGP check fails closed, and Limitations, not vulnerabilities says checksums give integrity only, the folder is unencrypted and the launchers are unsigned. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#limitations-not-vulnerabilities

dynamic_analysis.justification: No dynamic analysis tool is applied. CONTRIBUTING.md says a launcher is tested by running it by hand, and RELEASING.md's steps run no launcher. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates

dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions.justification: No dynamic analysis runs, so no configuration enables assertions in one. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates

dynamic_analysis_fixed.justification: No dynamic analysis runs, so it has found nothing. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates

dynamic_analysis_unsafe.justification: The project produces no software in a memory-unsafe language: it is bash, batch and PowerShell. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

english.justification: All documentation is in English, and issues are taken in English. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues

enhancement_responses.justification: Enhancement requests are issues like any other, and are answered or closed. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aclosed

external_dependencies.justification: The dependencies are Bitcoin Core, Electrum, gpg and the shells. README.md names them in prose, but no file lists them in a computer-processable way. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#prerequisites

floss_license_osi.justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).

governance.justification: GOVERNANCE.md, organization-wide in btclib-org/.github, documents the decision model and the roles; README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md link it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md

hardened_site.justification: The project site is GitHub, which sends Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options: deny. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

hardening.justification: On macOS and Linux the update, rollback, verify and validate scripts run under set -euo pipefail, so an unexpected failure stops them. The PGP check fails closed. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/linux/scripts/utilities/update-bitcoin.sh

implement_secure_design.justification: Fail-safe defaults: an update without enough good signatures from pinned keys is refused, and a rollback refuses to run while the node is up. Checksums are append-only. set-permissions restricts the data directories to the owner where the filesystem allows. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries

input_validation.justification: Menus accept only their listed numbers and reject anything else. A pin-file line that is not a 40-hex fingerprint, a min-signatures= line or a comment refuses the update. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries

installation_common.justification: PortaNode is a portable folder: git clone or the ZIP of main installs it, and deleting the folder removes it. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#getting-the-folder

installation_development_quick.justification: git clone, then uv: CONTRIBUTING.md's The environment and the gates gives the uvx commands that run every gate. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates

installation_standard_variables.justification: There is no installer that writes outside the folder; the folder may sit anywhere, and PORTANODE_ROOT overrides where it is looked for. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#environment-overrides

interact.justification: README.md says how to get the folder, how to report a bug and how to contribute. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

interfaces_current.justification: No script calls wmic, Get-WmiObject, egrep or fgrep. Downloads use curl and Invoke-WebRequest. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

internationalization.justification: Every message and menu is in English only.

know_common_errors.justification: The primary developer counters the common shell errors: shellcheck gates every .sh and .command script, the macOS and Linux updaters run under set -euo pipefail, and a pin-file line that is not a fingerprint refuses the update. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries

know_secure_design.justification: The primary developer designed the updaters to fail closed: an install needs good signatures from enough distinct pinned keys, and checksums are appended only after that. README.md's Limitations, not vulnerabilities states the trust model. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#limitations-not-vulnerabilities

license_per_file.justification: No script carries a license statement; the root LICENSE file holds it. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/LICENSE

maintenance_or_update.justification: Only the latest release is supported. Upgrading is pulling the folder again, and RELEASE_NOTES.md says what a user must act on. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

no_leaked_credentials.justification: detect-secrets and detect-private-key run in the required Lint check, and secret scanning has no alert. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.secrets.baseline

regression_tests_added50.justification: Recent fixes add a test in tests/ (#732, #736), but the share over six months is not measured. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/tests/README.md

release_notes.justification: Each GitHub release carries RELEASE_NOTES.md's section for it, written for a user, not a git log. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

release_notes_vulns.justification: No release has fixed a publicly known vulnerability: the repository has no security advisory. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/advisories

repo_distributed.justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.

repo_interim.justification: Every change lands on main between releases. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/commits/main

repo_public.justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

repo_track.justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git tracks what changed, who changed it and when. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/commits/main

report_process.justification: Bugs are reported in GitHub Issues, through the bug form. README.md's Getting Help and CONTRIBUTING.md's The issue tracker say where. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues

report_responses.justification: On 2026-10-23, 363 of the 383 issues filed were closed. The maintainer filed all but 11, which pmazzocchi filed between 2026-10-18 and 2026-10-20: 5 of them were closed by 2026-10-19, and the 6 open ones carry labels. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aclosed

report_tracker.justification: GitHub Issues, with an issue form under .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, and btclib-org/.github's tracker for cross-repository findings. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues

require_2FA.justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication of every member. https://github.com/btclib-org

roles_responsibilities.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's Roles names who holds each role and what each owes. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

secure_2FA.justification: The organization allows only secure two-factor methods, not SMS. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/1362#issuecomment-5903994882

security_review.justification: No security review of portanode has been performed. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

signed_releases.justification: Each release tag is signed with the maintainer's current key, and VERIFYING.md tells a user how to get the key and check a tag. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/VERIFYING.md

sites_https.justification: The project site is the GitHub repository, served over HTTPS only. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode

sites_password_security.justification: The project sites are GitHub only; the project runs no site that stores passwords.

small_tasks.justification: Small tasks for new contributors carry the label good first issue, which CONTRIBUTING.md sets aside for a first contribution. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues?q=label%3A%22good+first+issue%22

static_analysis.justification: shellcheck on every .sh and .command script, and zizmor and actionlint on the workflows, in the required Lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities.justification: shellcheck flags unquoted expansions and the injection and globbing errors they allow. zizmor audits the workflows for template injection and excessive permissions, and CodeQL runs over the workflow files. The required Script security check runs the security rules of PSScriptAnalyzer on the .ps1 scripts and of Blinter on the .bat scripts. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

static_analysis_fixed.justification: No vulnerability found by static analysis is open: shellcheck, zizmor and actionlint findings and the Script security check fail the merge, and CodeQL has no open alert. Code scanning shows one open OpenSSF Scorecard alert, SAST (alert 3, being closed by ISS 719). https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/lint.yml

static_analysis_often.justification: On every pull request and every push to main. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/actions/workflows/lint.yml

test.justification: tests/run.sh and tests/run.ps1 run the suite; the cases are published in the repository as FLOSS. test.yml runs tests/run.sh and the PowerShell tests that start no cmd.exe on Ubuntu, on every pull request and every push to main; its aggregate job `test: every job passed` is a required check. The macOS and Windows halves run by hand before a release. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/tests/README.md

test_branch_coverage80.justification: The suite in tests/ runs in CI, but its coverage is not measured. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/tests/README.md

test_continuous_integration.justification: test.yml runs tests/run.sh and the PowerShell tests that start no cmd.exe on Ubuntu, on every pull request and every push to main; its aggregate job `test: every job passed` is a required check. The macOS and Windows halves run by hand before a release. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml

test_invocation.justification: The suite is invoked in one command per platform: `bash tests/run.sh` on macOS and Linux, `pwsh -NoProfile -File tests\run.ps1` on Windows. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/tests/README.md

test_most.justification: tests/run.sh and the PowerShell tests that need no cmd.exe run on Ubuntu in CI; the rest run under tests/run.ps1 on Windows by hand. How much of the code they reach is not measured. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/tests/README.md

test_policy.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md says a major change adds or updates tests: one that gives a launcher or a helper a new behaviour, or corrects one. tests/README.md says how a test is added. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates

test_policy_mandated.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md says a major change adds or updates tests: one that gives a launcher or a helper a new behaviour, or corrects one. tests/README.md says how a test is added. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

test_statement_coverage80.justification: The suite in tests/ runs in CI, but its coverage is not measured. FLOSS coverage tools exist for bash, such as kcov. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/tests/README.md

test_statement_coverage90.justification: The suite in tests/ runs in CI, but its coverage is not measured. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/tests/README.md

tests_are_added.justification: Recent changes to a launcher or a helper add tests: pull request 717 (updaters on malformed downloads) changes two test files, 721 one, 701 added the suite. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged

tests_documented_added.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md says a major change adds or updates tests: one that gives a launcher or a helper a new behaviour, or corrects one. tests/README.md says how a test is added. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

two_person_review.justification: v2026.10.26 shipped 11 pull requests, none of them approved by somebody other than the author. The maintainer merges through the bypass, which main-self-merge keeps in pull_request mode. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#rulesets

updateable_reused_components.justification: The binaries are replaced by the update scripts, and rolled back by the rollback scripts. Dependabot moves the pinned actions weekly. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries

version_semver.justification: Calendar versioning, YYYY.M.D, with the day as the micro level. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md#the-version-string

version_tags_signed.justification: Every release tag is signed, and GitHub verifies each. VERIFYING.md names the current signing key by fingerprint and says how to verify a tag. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/VERIFYING.md

version_unique.justification: Each release has its own YYYY.M.D version and v-prefixed tag. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/releases

vulnerabilities_critical_fixed.justification: No vulnerability has been reported or found: the repository has no security advisory and no open alert. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security

vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days.justification: There is no security advisory and no open Dependabot alert. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security

vulnerability_report_credit.justification: No vulnerability report has been resolved: the repository has no security advisory. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/advisories

vulnerability_report_private.justification: A private GitHub security advisory, or email to security at btclib dot org. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/policy

vulnerability_report_process.justification: The security policy on the Security tab, the organization's SECURITY.md, gives the process. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/policy

vulnerability_report_response.justification: No vulnerability has been reported: the repository has no security advisory. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/advisories

vulnerability_response_process.justification: The security policy gives the private channels, who sees a report, and the timeframes for acknowledgement and fix. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/policy

warnings.justification: shellcheck reads every .sh and .command script in the required Lint check. The required Script security check runs the security rules of Blinter and PSScriptAnalyzer on the .bat and .ps1 scripts; their other rules are run by hand. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

warnings_fixed.justification: shellcheck findings fail the required Lint check. Script security runs every Blinter Warning rule, and each finding is fixed or accepted with its reason in .github/blinter-reasons.md. PSScriptAnalyzer's Warning findings on the .ps1 scripts are neither fixed nor recorded yet: ISS 739. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues/739

warnings_strict.justification: shellcheck runs at its default severity with none of its optional checks enabled. The required Script security check runs Blinter's Error, Security and Warning rules and PSScriptAnalyzer's security rules; PSScriptAnalyzer's other rules are run by hand. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/script-security.yml
